Capture header "What right looks like": the bar fills from the most relevant end — the three most relevant hints keep full verbs, the rest sit at bare key until the whole context is on the bar, then the tail gains verbs left to right; a hint that won't fit even bare is dropped, and `. more` is never dropped and sits at the head of the bare keys. The short rung shows where room runs out mid-hint (`F3 rend` here), and every short form is a prefix of the full verb — `stash`, `merge`, `rebase`, `compare`, `commit` have no short rung and keep their whole word at every width.
